title: Tile set contract (set.json), formatVersion 1; place design A3

ship.description: test: a CC0 stand-in that may be on the public sandbox, credited; yes: ours, or CC0 accepted for release

sourceTile.description: pixel size of a tile in the committed sheets

scale.description: integer nearest-neighbour factor the bake applies; sourceTile * scale = 48

palette.description: file with the colours (indices 48..) and the light tables

spriteSheet.description: PNG holding every prop, decal and canopy sprite

sheets.description: one 4x4 grid of the 16 tiles in corner order (NW*8+NE*4+SW*2+SE, a bit set = the upper terrain) per animation frame

fullSheet.description: one row of variants of the all-upper tile (index 15); variant 0 equals tile 15

emptySheet.description: optional row of variants of the all-lower tile (index 0)

rect.description: x, y, w, h of the first frame in the sprite sheet; further frames follow to the right at stride w

anchor.description: the foot pixel in rect-local source pixels; a canopy cut from a prop's sprite carries the same foot point in its own coordinates

footprint.description: tile offsets from the entity's cell that block; empty or absent: never blocks

canopy.description: name in the set's canopy table, drawn over the explorer with the cut-out
